correctness.rationale: For each of the 2592 family/parameter cases, the generator matrix is built directly over \(\mathbb F_{37}\), its row rank is checked to be 5, and the Euclidean hull dimension is computed as \(5-\operatorname{rank}(GG^{\mathsf T})\) by exact modular Gaussian elimination. The NMDS filter is the necessary-and-sufficient criterion in Theorems 4.2 and 4.3 of arXiv:2609.17304v1. All 1296 nonzero \((\eta,\delta)\) pairs are tested for each \(\ell\), the source-paper examples are reproduced, and the checker asserts the complete counts and exceptional lists before returning VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: This is a complete, exact parameter-selection map for 2592 code instances. It identifies exactly which NMDS members of two explicit \([13,5,8]_{37}\) families are LCD and which have a one-dimensional Euclidean hull. Hull behavior is not determined by NMDS parameters alone and is relevant when selecting classical codes for quantum-code constructions.
